fields.name: ArgentSeaDbGrainPersistence<TDatabaseOptions> database-backed grain-storage library contract
fields.contract: ArgentSeaDbGrainPersistence<TDatabaseOptions> implements the IGrainStorage read, write, and clear operations for configured grain types. Read initializes a missing model before database mapping and selects result-set versus output-parameter mapping from the query contract’s result format. Write requires a model state, sends generated input parameters to that type’s configured write query, and marks the record as existing after completion. Clear requires a model state, derives key parameters, sends that type’s configured clear query, and marks the record as absent after completion.
